body:
**Adversarial review, round 1** on `1bfdb80` by claude-opus-5-5 (builder: none recorded).

I'd block this merge as it stands. The spec text, the FR-007 cases and the specs/1.md front-matter all match the locked r2: prototype-ids.spec.ts checks both endpoints for 404 `{error:'unknown_sensor'}` across five prototype names. The main problem is that this PR can't pass its own required app-tests check. That check runs the spec 1 cases, but the epic/1 server at this head has no /history route. Its /latest still uses a plain object lookup, so `/sensors/constructor/latest` and similar answer 200, not 404. You need to either change the gate so sync/* PRs are expected to be red on these cases, or say plainly that the lead must bypass the check. There are also two low issues: the epic ruleset only allows squash, which drops the merge parent this sync creates, and `land` doesn't paginate the merged-PR list. The workflow inputs reach the script through env vars rather than inline in the shell, and the actor check against human_lead is fine.

- **F-1** [medium] Sync PR can't go green: app-tests runs the spec 1 cases against an epic/1 server that has neither /history nor the FR-007 guard — `.github/workflows/gates.yml:39`
  On any head branch not named draft/*, gates.yml runs the full `npx playwright test`, and `sync/1-r2` is not a draft/* branch. That suite includes app/cases/1/history.spec.ts and the new app/cases/1/prototype-ids.spec.ts. At this PR's head, app/src/server.ts only routes `/sensors/{id}/latest`. A history request falls through to 404 `not_found`, so every history case fails. On /latest, `readings[id]` is a plain object lookup (server.ts:13). For `constructor`, `toString`, `hasOwnProperty` and `valueOf` it returns a function, so the 404 check is skipped and the server answers 200, which is exactly the r2 bug. app-tests is a required check in setup/ruleset-epic.json, so this sync PR can't merge without a bypass. The milestone PR needs these cases on epic/1, so the epic lane deadlocks. Fix options: exempt sync/* heads from the spec cases the same way draft/* is exempted, or say explicitly that the lead must bypass. Making only the gate less strict would let other red cases through as well, so fix the flow.
- **F-2** [low] Epic ruleset only allows squash, which throws away the merge parent this sync exists to create — `setup/ruleset-epic.json:29`
  lanes/epic-pr.ts makes a real merge commit of main into sync/<id>-r<rev>, but epic/** only allows `squash`. Squashing this PR puts main's changes on epic/1 as a plain commit with no main ancestry. The next sync, or the land PR, will merge main again from an older merge base and can conflict on files both sides changed (specs/1.md already is one). Allow `merge` on epic/** for sync/* heads, or explain why ancestry doesn't matter.
- **F-3** [low] `land` reads merged PRs without pagination, so milestones and provenance can be dropped silently — `lanes/epic-pr.ts:34`
  `pulls?state=closed&base=...&per_page=100` gets only the first page. Once an epic has had more than 100 closed PRs, the land PR body leaves out milestones and their adp-provenance records without any warning. That breaks the claim that the body carries every milestone's provenance. Paginate, or refuse when 100 results come back.


Only @dharishan04 can close a finding without a fix: `/dismiss <F-n> <reason>`.

<sub>Reviewer ran in Claude Code on @dharishan04's laptop (claude-opus-5-5, self-declared); posted by run 39398342619.</sub>
